increments.title: Upload documents: every save button checks a part-filled document and never drops one
increments.detail: BA find, 23 Oct. On animals Upload documents, Save and continue drops a part-filled document with no error whenever no document type is chosen (startsADocument in documents/form/payload.js:45-48 counts only an offered type), and Save and return to overview always leaves via leavePage, throwing away even a complete document (documents/controller.js:293-335). Save and add another already checks correctly through documentAddErrors (form/errors.js:54-61). The all-or-nothing rule (Confluence 6497338582, Documents: 'Optional - All-or-nothing') is the document's own rule, so under the 7 October ruling (c-211) Save and return refuses a half-filled document rather than skipping it. Fix: a document is started when any of reference, type (offered or not), date text or a file with content is given; route by that on every button; on Save and return, a complete document is saved and the trader goes to the overview. Unit tests at controller.test.js:582-614 pin the current wrong behaviour and change. Origin and main reason for import are as designed (only required-answer checks are skipped on Save and return). Plants has no upload documents page, so it is unaffected. Assumes Sam confirms the all-or-nothing group counts as its own rule (recommended, matches the BA's scenario).
acceptanceCriteria: Given I am adding a document and have given some but not all of its reference, type, date of issue and attachment, when I select Save and add another, Save and continue or Save and return to overview, then I stay on the page with an error for each detail not given, what I typed is kept, and no document is added. (BA, 23 Oct; spec REQ-DOCS-016)
Given a reference, date of issue and attachment but no type, when I select Save and continue, then I see 'Select a document type' and no document is added.
Given every detail of a document is filled in, when I select Save and return to overview, then Overview is shown and reopening Upload documents lists the document.
Given nothing is filled in, when I select Save and return to overview, then Overview is shown with no error.
Given a document with an impossible date or an unsupported file type, when I select Save and return to overview, then that field's error is shown and nothing is added.
The same holds without JavaScript.

openspec upload-documents REQ-DOCS-016 covers every save button and defines a started document as any of the four details, and journey-flow REQ-FLOW-004 gains a scenario that an all-or-nothing group is refused on Save and return; coverage links follow.

sources.ref: BA bug report 23 Oct (Save and continue / Save and return drop a part-filled document); investigation of origin/main documents/controller.js:293-335, form/payload.js:45-48, controller.test.js:582-614

openQuestions: Sam (with the BA): should Save and return to overview make the same checks as Save and continue on every page, or only refuse rule breaks (format, list, all-or-nothing) while skipping blank required answers, as the 7 October ruling says? Evidence on what the prototype and the Confluence requirements do is being gathered for Monday.
notes: Sam, 23 Oct: do not assume the 7 October soft-save ruling (c-211) is right; the BA is challenging it. The BA's wider finding stands as an open issue: on upload, origin and main reason for import, Save and return to overview skips the checks Save and continue makes. The detail above calling origin and main reason 'as designed' only describes the current ruling, not a decision that it is correct. Settle the question below before building; the documents fix may become part of a wider change to Save and return on every page.

Evidence for the Save and return question (23 Oct): (1) Sam's 7 Oct ruling never mentions Save and return; it only sets precedence (prototype wins unless validation/persistence/auth/cross-service). c-211 applied it from one prototype test on one page (COVERAGE.md:59) and did not weigh Confluence; plants' 'same checks' behaviour (d-059) was overruled by c-313 via an orchestrator-applied claim, not Sam's own decision. (2) Prototype is mixed: origin, main reason, arrival, transit, transporter, roles lenient; upload documents makes Save and continue's checks on Save and return once a type is chosen; consignment details, CPH, contact strict. (3) Confluence 6497338582 has two tiers, 'Mandatory to proceed' and 'Mandatory to submit', never defining 'proceed'; every field the BA tested is 'to proceed' (region code when Yes, the reason's follow-ups, a document once its type is chosen). (4) The spec (journey-flow REQ-FLOW-004, origin line 177, import-reason 97 and 213) states the lenient rule plainly. (5) GOV.UK task-list guidance leans lenient, but is guidance only. Options: (A) same checks everywhere (animals 4 controllers, plants 5, spec and soft-save e2e rewritten, c-211/c-313 re-ruled; traders cannot park a half-done page); (A-narrow) refuse blank 'Mandatory to proceed' fields on Save and return, skip 'to submit' ones (covers all three BA pages; needs 'proceed' defined); (B) keep the lenient rule and fix documents only. Under every option Save and return must stop dropping a complete document. Also found: the transporter page already refuses a blank choice on Save and return, against c-211's list.
